items.description: Map the repository modules, helper scripts, and artifact dependencies before research execution
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/research_context.md` with a module inventory covering `README.md`, `TASK_orchestrator.md`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `results/research_context.*`, `results/literature/*`, `results/swarm/*`, and `results/verification/*`; include a data-flow summary, note that `results/verification/` starts empty, and record blocking defects such as the `concept_evolve.py evolve()` launcher mismatch.
items.notes: Mapped repo modules and data flow in results/research_context.md; recorded missing TASK_orchestrator.md, empty verification start state, repaired concept_evolve evolve() launcher mismatch, and documented the first mandatory evolve attempt drifting without artifact output.

items.description: Freeze the active research problem from the saved swarm state before any implementation
items.acceptance_criteria: Research notes explicitly state `H1_multisource_cold_start` as champion, `H2_cryo_support_blocks` as backup, and `H3_dynamic_source_impedance` as reserve after reading `results/swarm/hypotheses.json` and `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`; copy the exact kill rules, first experiment, and budget envelope into the working plan.
items.notes: Froze H1 as champion, H2 as backup, and H3 as reserve in results/research_context.md using results/swarm/hypotheses.json and results/swarm/tool_plan.md; copied exact first experiment, global budgets, H1 budget envelope, and lane kill rules into the working plan.

items.description: Repair the off-target literature snapshot with a targeted web and Semantic Scholar pass
items.acceptance_criteria: Extend `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` rather than replacing it: preserve the original seed snapshot, add a focused section for the champion lane, log targeted web queries plus Semantic Scholar graph traversals, and include at least 10 directly relevant EE papers covering multi-source cold start, startup interfaces, anti-backdrive, and weak-source harvesting; the focused set must include `Review of Fully Integrated Startup Techniques for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting Systems (2023)`, `Power Management for Multi-Source Energy Harvesting Systems: A Review (2024)`, and `Fully Autonomous Self-Starting Interface Circuit for Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting from Multi-Source Inputs (2024)`.
items.notes: Extended results/literature/literature_snapshot.json with a focused H1 lane section preserving the seed snapshot, logging 3 targeted web queries and 11 Semantic Scholar traversals, resolving the fuzzy anchor titles explicitly, and curating 15 directly relevant startup/multi-input harvesting papers.

items.description: Create and maintain the repository bibliography as a first-class research artifact
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `sources.bib` in the repo root and keep it updated throughout the run; include BibTeX entries for every consulted paper, repository, dataset, and official documentation source, with at least 10 relevant papers and complete DOI or URL fields when available.
items.notes: Created sources.bib with 16 focused H1 paper entries and validated DOI-or-URL coverage for every current entry; malformed helper-generated placeholders were replaced with a curated BibTeX set.

items.description: Build and maintain the prior-art differentiation matrix and explicit watchlist novelty check
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` after each literature decision; fill dated differentiation notes for `Leading change (2018)`, `Fostering STEAM through challenge-based learning, robotics, and physical devices: A systematic mapping literature review (2020)`, `Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Robotics and Nature of Consciousness (2022)`, and `The north wing of the Musin-Pushkin estate in Moscow: historical, architectural and field studies (2022)`, then add the closest H1 papers with why-it-is-close, differentiation hypothesis, evidence artifacts, and pivot decision.
items.notes: Filled dated differentiation notes for the watchlist false-neighbor papers and added the closest real H1 overlap papers (startup TEG family, multi-source battery-less PMUs, recent self-powered multi-input piezo interfaces, and the recovered closest review) with why-close, differentiation hypothesis, evidence artifacts, and pivot guidance.

items.description: Run a multi-agent literature and concept-tree scout pass and synthesize it into a champion concept set
items.acceptance_criteria: `explorer`, `hypothesis_scout`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` perform one focused pass that populates `results/concept_evolve/tree/` with at least 6 concept folders plus `index.json`, `adjacency.json`, and `walk_paths.json`; if the helper launcher fails, document the exact blocker and workaround in `results/concept_evolve/tooling_blockers.md` and still produce an integrator memo selecting the top 3 concept folders.
items.notes: Used a focused multi-agent equivalent path after the repaired broad-task evolve run stayed low-signal: explorer, hypothesis_scout, novelty_checker, and integrator artifacts now populate results/concept_evolve/, including 6 concept folders under tree/, index/adjacency/walk_paths JSON, tooling_blockers.md, and an integrator memo selecting the top 3 folders.

items.description: Gate the execution environment and unblock required research tooling before baseline work
items.acceptance_criteria: Record whether `ngspice` is installed, whether `.archivara/concept_evolve.py` commands can run, and any missing dependencies; either working commands are listed in a setup note or blocking defects are logged with exact failing call sites and an owner.
items.notes: Recorded tooling gate status in results/setup/tooling_status.md: ngspice missing and rootless install blocked by DNS, concept_evolve evolve launcher repaired but broad-task run low-signal, and probe/reframe child paths failing with response-stream disconnects and placeholder artifacts.

items.description: Define the champion concept folder structure, baseline interfaces, and dependency map
items.acceptance_criteria: Choose one champion folder under `results/concept_evolve/tree/` for H1 and create a dependency note that names shared subcircuits, source models, control blocks, baseline folders, result tables, and verification outputs; all later artifacts must link back to this folder.

items.description: Specify the source model, measurement hooks, and success metrics for weak multi-source cold start
items.acceptance_criteria: The baseline spec includes source voltages `20/50/100/300 mV`, ramp rates `0.1/1/10/100 mV/s`, impedance ratios `1:1/1:5/1:20`, mixed-polarity cases, and the four required metrics: startup success, time-to-handoff, back-drive loss, and startup-control energy.

items.description: Implement and parameterize two strong baseline startup paths with equal accounting
items.acceptance_criteria: At least two baselines exist for the same source matrix: a fixed startup path and a non-source-aware multi-input startup or arbitration path; both expose identical measurement hooks, no hidden helper rail, and equalized energy accounting for control, arbitration, and isolation overhead.

items.description: Use multi-agent benchmark design review before running the core concept
items.acceptance_criteria: `worker`, `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` sign off on the baseline set and metric definitions in one memo; the memo explicitly rejects weak comparisons such as open-loop-only or fixed-threshold-only baselines.

items.description: Generate and rank source-adaptive cold-start architecture variants inside the concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: At least 3 H1 variants are represented under the champion concept subtree, covering different strategies for source or polarity inference, minimum-energy accumulation, and handoff gating; each variant has a short README, dependency list, and predicted failure mode.

items.description: Implement the champion topology family and one ablation family in modular netlist form
items.acceptance_criteria: A modular netlist or equivalent circuit decomposition exists for the selected champion H1 topology plus at least one ablation that removes source awareness; shared subcircuits are factored once and referenced by both designs.

items.description: Run an explicit novelty screen against named prior work before claiming a contribution
items.acceptance_criteria: A claim matrix compares the proposed topology against `Review of Fully Integrated Startup Techniques for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting Systems (2023)`, `Power Management for Multi-Source Energy Harvesting Systems: A Review (2024)`, `Fully Autonomous Self-Starting Interface Circuit for Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting from Multi-Source Inputs (2024)`, and the watchlist papers named in `results/literature/prior_art_watchlist.md`; every claimed difference is linked to evidence or downgraded.

items.description: Iterate the concept tree using research feedback rather than ad hoc local changes
items.acceptance_criteria: Run `.archivara/concept_evolve.py iterate` or a documented equivalent after the first novelty or falsifier pass; update `results/concept_evolve/bridge_candidates.json`, `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.json`, and `results/concept_evolve/recurrent_state.json` with promoted bridges, retired bridges, and next experiments for H1.

items.description: Use multi-agent core research synthesis to select one champion and one kill-ready fallback
items.acceptance_criteria: `research_director`, `hypothesis_scout`, `novelty_checker`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` produce a single selection memo that keeps exactly one H1 champion architecture active, records one fallback, and explains why other branches were retired.

items.description: Execute the champion go-kill startup matrix in ngspice within the stated budget
items.acceptance_criteria: Run a startup matrix of no more than 24 cases that still covers every level of source voltage, ramp rate, impedance ratio, and at least one mixed-polarity condition; store raw outputs and a case manifest under the champion concept folder.

items.description: Benchmark the champion against the two baselines with equal overhead accounting
items.acceptance_criteria: For every executed case, report champion and both baselines on startup success, time-to-handoff, back-drive loss, and startup-control energy; include one comparison table that maps the tested operating regimes against the closest literature cases identified in Phase 1.

items.description: Stress the claim with adversarial source conditions and blocker-triggered fallback checks
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least 6 falsifier cases spanning source collapse, polarity mismatch, extreme impedance asymmetry, and UVLO chatter; if H1 fails its kill rule, immediately run the backup activation gate for H2 or the reserve overlap screen for H3 as defined in `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`.

items.description: Use multi-agent monitoring and audit during experiment execution
items.acceptance_criteria: `worker`, `monitor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` maintain a run log that records completed cases, blocked cases, instrumentation errors, and any benchmark changes; no new sweep is launched after an auditor block without an integrator note.

items.description: Make a lane promotion or kill decision from evidence, not intuition
items.acceptance_criteria: A decision memo states whether H1 is promoted, killed, or narrowed; the memo references the measured advantage threshold, the direct-overlap check, the baseline audit, the literature comparison, and the remaining budget for H2 or H3 if activation is required.

items.description: Analyze mechanism, sensitivity, and boundary conditions of the winning concept
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce a short analysis package that explains why the champion wins or fails, including sensitivity to source impedance spread, ramp rate, polarity mix, and control overhead; identify the smallest condition set where the claim still holds.

items.description: Complete the bibliography and source-to-claim audit
items.acceptance_criteria: `sources.bib` contains BibTeX entries for every paper, repository, and documentation source consulted during the run, including at least 10 relevant papers; `results/verification/citation_audit.md` audits at least 12 load-bearing claims against those sources and flags unsupported wording such as `first` or `novel`.

items.description: Produce a novelty-market verification artifact pack under results/verification
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md` all exist; each file states pass or block status, the reviewed scope, and the next required action.

items.description: Use multi-agent writing and review to bound the claim and final narrative
items.acceptance_criteria: `writer`, `reviewer`, `citation_auditor`, `benchmark_auditor`, and `integrator` produce one final research brief that contains only validated claims, references the closest prior work, lists the kill conditions that remain open, and rejects any broader story not backed by experiments.

items.description: Finalize the reproducibility bundle in the champion concept folder and repo root
items.acceptance_criteria: The champion folder README links to netlists, manifests, result tables, verification reports, and unresolved blockers; the repo root contains `research_rubric.json`, `sources.bib`, and updated context files so another researcher can restart from the current state without rereading the entire history.
